title: Session note
description: Agent-authored semantic handover/summary/outcome note bound to a repo, project, and optional work-item refs. The cooperative counterpart to session-capsule/v1's no-cooperation mechanical exhaust.
$comment: This schema mirrors structure for editor support. templates/dispatch/scripts/validate_session_mechanization_artifacts.py is normative for cross-field rules.

origin_stream_id.description: Durable producer outbox stream identity (adr-outbox-sync-model), same semantics as session-capsule/v1. Never a remote-origin id.

runtime_session_id.description: Same field semantics as session-capsule/v1. Null for manual (non-runtime-tracked) sessions.

project.description: Portable repo scope identifier, e.g. the sprintctl repo name.

repo_id.description: Minted repo_id from the dispatch manifest, once repos carry it. Optional until that migration lands.

note_kind.description: Deliberately only three kinds in v1; governance and process-observation kinds were considered and deferred pending a demonstrated consumer.

target_refs.description: Zero or more prefixed refs from the wi:/sprint: vocabulary (dispatch-manifest.md).

capsule_ref.description: Immutable ref to the session's session-capsule/v1, when one exists.

supersedes.description: Nullable note_id of the note this one supersedes, forming the repeated-/clear chain. Chains are not assumed linear: concurrent sessions can produce multiple heads.

body.description: Markdown, capped at 16 KiB (16384 bytes) so notes stay handover-sized, not transcript-sized.
